name: Process Redesign
description: Redesign a recurring operational process using demand, flow, constraints, decision rules, controls, automation opportunities, experiments, and measurable rollout.

tasks.name: Measure current system
tasks.objective: Capture demand volume/variation, arrival patterns, cycle and wait time, queues, work-in-progress, rework, defects, handoffs, decision points, staffing/capacity, controls, tools, and customer/user outcomes.

tasks.name: Identify constraints and root causes
tasks.objective: Separate symptoms from causes; locate bottlenecks, batching, unclear criteria, duplicate work, information delays, incentive problems, control failures, skill gaps, and avoidable variation.

tasks.name: Set redesign principles
tasks.objective: Define target outcomes, service levels, control requirements, ownership, decision rights, accessibility, data needs, acceptable risk, and explicit tradeoffs before selecting solutions.

tasks.name: Design future-state flow
tasks.objective: Remove unnecessary steps, combine or parallelize work, clarify decision rules, reduce handoffs, define standard work and exceptions, rebalance capacity, and identify automation only where inputs and rules are stable enough.

tasks.name: Pilot and instrument
tasks.objective: Run controlled pilots on representative demand including edge cases; measure cycle time, quality, workload, exceptions, customer impact, control performance, and unintended consequences.

tasks.name: Roll out and govern
tasks.objective: Define training, cutover, ownership, dashboards, escalation, rollback criteria, documentation, review cadence, continuous-improvement intake, and retirement of the old process.
